Student Academic Advising Information System (SAAIS) API (0.3.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:

License: Proprietary

Target SAAIS API contract: read-only PostgREST projections and authenticated transactional Edge Function writes. The confirmed SRS governs business rules across the six assignable roles (student, adviser, department_head, department_staff, dean, admin) and multi-role account assignments. This specification and its x-required-roles metadata do not implement authorization, pagination, rate limiting or database guards: those must be enforced by the gateway, RLS and verified server operations before deployment. Supabase Auth handles hosted sessions and password/Google flows; this contract describes application provisioning and academic operations. Daily scheduled alert and INC cache evaluation runs server-side via pg_cron, while POST /functions/v1/notifications/evaluate-alerts exposes idempotent on-demand alert evaluation for Department Heads, Admins, and deterministic mock testing. Email/password and Google OAuth, PKCE callbacks, session refresh and logout are Supabase-managed SDK flows, not custom application endpoints. See x-supabase-auth-integration and contract/SUPABASE-AUTH.md for the client/gateway integration contract.

Auth

User authentication, invitation provisioning, and password setup

Send account invitation

Unified account provisioning and invitation flow: atomically creates a pre-registered Profile (status='invited'), multi-role RoleAssignment rows, and initial student curriculum / adviser assignments (when student is included), and dispatches a single-use expiring password-setup invitation email (/invite/:token). Pre-registered accounts may also sign in immediately with Google OAuth on the exact provisioned @vsu.edu.ph email; the first verified Google sign-in activates the profile (status='active') and invalidates any unused password invite token. Admins may provision any role and grant multi-role assignments across the institution; Department Heads and Department Staff may provision student, adviser, and department_staff accounts (including multi-role combinations restricted to those roles) strictly within their own department scope. Any attempt by Department Head or Department Staff to grant admin, dean, or department_head roles or assign another department/faculty is explicitly rejected with 403 Forbidden. Enforces @vsu.edu.ph institutional email and rejects duplicate email or student_number with 409 Conflict. Privileged server code provisions the Supabase Auth identity and application profile/assignments and writes an immutable audit log entry with server-derived actor and timestamp; the SPA never calls Auth admin APIs or receives server credentials. An application invitation does not constitute a signed-in session.

Verify invitation token and set initial password

Application invitation redemption: accepts the single-use expiring application token from the invitation email, enforces the SAAIS password policy (12–128 characters with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one digit), sets the initial password in Supabase Auth through privileged server code, marks the invitation accepted, and activates the provisioned profile. Requires the public project apikey but no Authorization/user session. This is not Supabase /auth/v1/verify, a Google callback or a login endpoint. The handler must validate the token before any privileged work and must be deployable without a gateway user-JWT requirement. Future gateway/handler configuration is required; this contract does not apply it. Success returns activation acknowledgement, not an access/refresh token; use the Supabase SDK to sign in afterward.

Authorizations:
supabaseProjectKey
Request Body schema: application/json
required
token
required
string [ 1 .. 2048 ] characters \S

Opaque application invitation token, not a user JWT, OAuth authorization code, refresh token or Supabase token_hash. Validate expiry and single-use redemption server-side; never log the token or password.

password
required
string <password> [ 12 .. 128 ] characters

Initial account password: 12 to 128 characters, requiring at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one digit. Validated server-side before activating the account.

Preview invitation metadata without consuming token

Pre-session, non-consuming invitation preview for the Invite landing card (Invite.dc.html). Accepts the opaque invitation token in the POST body (avoiding token exposure in server URL access logs or Referer headers) and returns only the bounded invitation summary needed to render the card (provisioned email, full_name, role, roles, faculty_name, department_name, program_code, expires_at, and invitation_status). Requires the public project apikey without a user session JWT and is rate-limited by IP and token hash. Never consumes or extends the token and never returns internal profile IDs or tokens.

Decline an active account invitation token

Pre-session invitation decline action from the Invite landing card (Invite.dc.html). Accepts the single-use expiring invitation token in the POST body, atomically invalidates the token, transitions invitation_status to declined in a race-safe compare-and-set against concurrent redemption or revocation, and writes an audit log entry. Requires the public project apikey without a user session JWT. Returns 409 Conflict if the invitation was already accepted, revoked, expired, or declined.

Profile

User profiles, multi-role assignments, and institutional accounts

Query user profiles

List or filter user profiles via PostgREST query parameters. Students can only select their own profile via RLS. Advisers can select assigned advisees. Department Heads and Department Staff can select department-scoped profiles. Deans can select faculty-scoped profiles. Admins have system-wide visibility. Flat columns are allowlisted per x-projection-fields; role metadata documents checks, not automatic runtime authorization. Inaccessible/missing collection rows return 200 [], while invalid role/column requests may return 403.

Resend or regenerate an account invitation

Department Head, Department Staff, or Admin regenerates and resends an expiring invitation email for an account whose invitation is still pending (invited), expired, or previously revoked/declined, without exposing the raw token in API responses. Department Head and Department Staff may only resend invitations for Students, Advisers, and Department Staff within their own department (admin, dean, and department_head accounts are Admin-only). Invalidates any prior unused token hash, updates invitation_status to pending, stamps invitation_sent_at and invitation_expires_at server-side, and writes an audit log entry.

Revoke a pending account invitation

Department Head, Department Staff, or Admin revokes a pending account invitation before redemption, invalidating its token hash, setting invitation_status to revoked, and writing an audit log entry. Department Head and Department Staff may only revoke invitations for Students, Advisers, and Department Staff within their own department (admin, dean, and department_head accounts are Admin-only). Already redeemed (accepted) invitations cannot be revoked and return 409 Conflict.

(supabaseProjectKeybearerAuth)
query Parameters
id
string <= 1900 characters ^(?:(?:eq|neq)\.[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}...

Allowlisted PostgREST UUID filter: eq.UUID, neq.UUID or in.(UUID,...), at most 50 IDs. URL-encode the complete value; format:uuid would be wrong for the operator-prefixed string.

name
string <= 156 characters ^(?:eq|ilike|like)\.[^\x00-\x1f]{1,150}$

Filter by name equality or pattern matching

select
string <= 2000 characters ^(?:id|name|code|letterhead_prefix|letterhead...
Default: "id,name,code,letterhead_prefix,letterhead_name,dean_name"

Only these flat safe columns. On private-column tables the client must explicitly send this projection; PostgREST does not apply OpenAPI defaults.

order
string <= 1000 characters ^(?:id|name|code|letterhead_prefix|letterhead...
Default: "id.asc"

Stable ordering on published columns only; whitelist and enforce at runtime.

limit
integer [ 1 .. 1000 ]
Default: 20
Example: limit=20

Bounded page size; gateway/PostgREST max-rows must enforce this cap even when clients omit or bypass contract validation.

offset
integer [ 0 .. 100000 ]
Default: 0
Example: offset=0

Number of rows to skip for DoS pagination mitigation

Close grade encoding for a school term

Department Head, Department Staff, or Admin closes grade encoding for the specified school term. Department Head and Department Staff close grade encoding for their own department (scope: department, updating the department's (school_term_id, department_id) closure state with is_closed=true and stamping closed_by and closed_at server-side). System Administrators may close grade encoding for a specific department (scope: department, requiring department_id) or institution-wide (scope: institution, setting global SchoolTerm.is_locked=true). Cross-department or non-Admin institution-wide closure requests are rejected with 403 Forbidden. Commits an audit log entry in the same transaction.

Authorizations:
(supabaseProjectKeybearerAuth)
path Parameters
school_term_id
required
string <uuid>
Request Body schema: application/json
required
scope
string
Default: "department"
Enum: "department" "institution"

Closure scope: department closes grade encoding for a single department (department_head and department_staff are restricted to their own department); institution sets global SchoolTerm.is_locked=true and is Admin-only.

department_id
string or null <uuid>

Target department UUID when scope: department. For Department Head and Department Staff callers, defaults to and must match the caller's assigned department. Required when an Admin closes encoding for a specific department.

closure_note
string or null <= 2000 characters

Responses

Hosted Supabase HTTPS gateway; configure the real project reference. Production requests require HTTPS; no specific TLS version is assumed.

Query adviser assignments

Retrieve student-to-adviser longitudinal assignments, including safe display names (adviser_name, handed_over_to_name, handover_label) for student and staff views without exposing private reassignment reason text or broadening /rest/v1/profile RLS. RLS-scoped: students view their own assignments; advisers view assigned advisees; department/faculty roles view scoped students; admins have full visibility. Flat columns are allowlisted per x-projection-fields; role metadata documents checks, not automatic runtime authorization. Inaccessible/missing collection rows return 200 [], while invalid role/column requests may return 403.

Bulk reassign adviser for multiple students

Record enrollment or missing grades

Lock student/offering/attempt and recheck current assignment, selected term membership and strict clearance at commit (or record an audited prerequisite override when continue_with_prerequisite_override is true with prerequisite_override_reason). Blank new grades enroll; first new midterm requires confirmation. Existing submitted populated grade rejects entire request even if identical. Return actionable conflict codes; no partial grade or audit write. Derive final-only Passed/Failed or explicit INC/DR/NA status. Term lock blocks writes unless override applies.

Read immutable scoped audit history

Read-only, row-scoped PostgREST collection. Advisers view assigned advisees; Department Heads view department-scoped entries; Deans view faculty-scoped entries; Admins view all entries. Supports actor, action, action_category, entity_type, student, free-text search, and bounded created_at range filtering (both single boundary via created_at and lower+upper bounds via and=(created_at.gte.<from>,created_at.lte.<to>)).

List and filter student academic roster

Paginated, server-filtered student roster and advisee list for Adviser (All Students, My Advisees), Department Head (Student Records, Advisee Assignments), Department Staff (Student Records, Grade Encoding student selector), Dean (Student Records), and System Administrator (Student Records). Combines profile identity, active curriculum/program and entry batch, derived year level, cumulative/curriculum GWA, units earned vs. total curriculum units, academic standing, deficiency count, active adviser assignment (and handover metadata), and last advising/activity timestamp without N+1 client waterfalls. Row visibility is strictly enforced server-side per caller role and assignment scope.

Authorizations:
(supabaseProjectKeybearerAuth)
query Parameters
limit
integer [ 1 .. 1000 ]
Default: 20
Example: limit=20

Bounded page size; gateway/PostgREST max-rows must enforce this cap even when clients omit or bypass contract validation.

offset
integer [ 0 .. 100000 ]
Default: 0
Example: offset=0

Number of rows to skip for DoS pagination mitigation

search
string <= 150 characters

Search text. Server uses parameterized queries; no client-defined query language.

assignment_scope
string
Default: "all"
Enum: "all" "current" "past" "my_active_advisees" "my_handed_over_advisees" "unassigned"

Filter by caller advisee relationship (all visible students in caller scope, current / my_active_advisees, past / my_handed_over_advisees, unassigned).

adviser_id
string <uuid>

Filter by active assigned adviser UUID.

unassigned_only
boolean

When true, return only students without an active adviser assignment.

faculty_id
string <uuid>

Filter by student's derived faculty/college UUID.

department_id
string <uuid>

Filter by student's derived department UUID.

program_id
string <uuid>

Filter by student's active degree program UUID.

curriculum_version_id
string <uuid>

Filter by student's active curriculum version UUID.

entry_year
integer [ 1900 .. 2100 ]

Filter by student cohort/entry academic year (e.g. 2023).

year_level
integer [ 1 .. 6 ]

Filter by derived student year level (1 to 6).

standing
string (AcademicStanding)
Enum: "good_standing" "warning" "probation" "dismissed"

Filter by derived academic standing (good_standing, warning, probation, dismissed).

has_deficiencies
boolean

Filter students who currently have (true) or do not have (false) active failed/INC/dropped deficiencies.

has_open_inc
boolean

Filter students who currently have (true) or do not have (false) open incomplete (INC) attempts.

has_open_flags
boolean

Filter students who currently have (true) or do not have (false) open student-submitted grade flags.

school_term_id
string <uuid>

Optional school term context for term-specific advising/encoding status.

sort_by
string
Default: "full_name"
Enum: "full_name" "student_number" "year_level" "gwa" "units_earned" "standing" "last_activity_at"

Sort column for the student roster.

sort_dir
string
Default: "asc"
Enum: "asc" "desc"

Sort direction (asc or desc).

Responses

Record sensitive student-record view, report view, or export audit event

Records an append-only audit log entry when an authorized user views a sensitive student record, views a department/faculty/admin summary report (report_viewed), or confirms a PDF/CSV export (FR-AUD-05). Pre-authentication or auth-lifecycle events (login_rejected, sign_in_succeeded, password_changed) are recorded exclusively by server-side Supabase Auth hooks and Edge Functions—never via this authenticated client endpoint.

Authorizations:
(supabaseProjectKeybearerAuth)
Request Body schema: application/json
required
event_type
required
string
Enum: "student_record_viewed" "report_viewed" "pdf_exported" "csv_exported" "report_exported"

Authenticated client view/export audit event type. Auth-lifecycle events (login_rejected, sign_in_succeeded, password_changed) are recorded exclusively by server-side Supabase Auth hooks and Edge Functions.

student_id
string or null <uuid>
report_type
string or null
Enum: "adviser_dashboard" "department" "faculty" "institution" null
object or null
details
string or null <= 1000 characters

Responses

Hosted Supabase HTTPS gateway; configure the real project reference. Production requests require HTTPS; no specific TLS version is assumed.

Notifications & Settings

In-app notification center, configurable delinquency thresholds, and backup metadata

Query user notifications

Read-only PostgREST collection of in-app notifications scoped to the authenticated user's recipient_id (FR-NOT-01).

Authorizations:
(supabaseProjectKeybearerAuth)
query Parameters
id
string <= 1900 characters ^(?:(?:eq|neq)\.[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}...

Allowlisted PostgREST UUID filter: eq.UUID, neq.UUID or in.(UUID,...), at most 50 IDs. URL-encode the complete value; format:uuid would be wrong for the operator-prefixed string.

is_read
string <= 20 characters ^eq\.(true|false)$

Filter by read state (eq.true or eq.false).

kind
string <= 32 characters ^eq\.(note|grade|alert|flag|import|person|tra...

Filter by notification icon/category kind (eq.<kind>).

event_type
string <= 80 characters ^eq\.[a-z0-9_]{3,64}$

Filter by notification trigger event type (eq.<event_type>).

target_student_id
string <= 100 characters ^eq\.[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F...

Filter by associated student UUID (eq.UUID).

select
string <= 2000 characters ^(?:id|recipient_id|kind|event_type|title|bod...
Default: "id,recipient_id,kind,event_type,title,body,target_route,target_student_id,actor_id,entity_type,entity_id,dedupe_key,email_delivery_status,is_read,read_at,created_at"

Only these flat safe columns.

order
string <= 1000 characters ^(?:id|recipient_id|kind|event_type|title|bod...
Default: "created_at.desc"

Stable ordering on published columns only.

limit
integer [ 1 .. 1000 ]
Default: 20
Example: limit=20

Bounded page size; gateway/PostgREST max-rows must enforce this cap even when clients omit or bypass contract validation.

offset
integer [ 0 .. 100000 ]
Default: 0
Example: offset=0

Number of rows to skip for DoS pagination mitigation

Responses

Hosted Supabase HTTPS gateway; configure the real project reference. Production requests require HTTPS; no specific TLS version is assumed.

Loopback-only local Supabase sandbox. HTTP is permitted only for local development.

Evaluate idempotent deadline and standing notifications

Evaluates deadline-driven and threshold-driven notifications (approaching INC deadlines, lapsed INCs, academic standing / delinquency changes, approaching grade-encoding closure, unassigned students, expiring account invitations, and overdue backup reminders) as of reference_date (defaults to current Asia/Manila date). Uses deterministic dedupe_key values so repeated evaluations never emit duplicate notifications. In production, pg_cron invokes the same server evaluation routine daily; in mock/MSW testing, handlers run it lazily on session bootstrap and allow Department Heads / Admins (or test harnesses) to pass any reference_date to simulate time-based alerts deterministically.

Authorizations:
(supabaseProjectKeybearerAuth)
Request Body schema: application/json
optional
reference_date
string or null <date>

Optional Asia/Manila date used to evaluate deadline and reminder windows deterministically.

department_id
string or null <uuid>

Optional department scope filter (defaults to caller department for Department Head or all departments for Admin).

dry_run
boolean
Default: false

When true, computes candidate notifications without inserting rows.

Responses

Hosted Supabase HTTPS gateway; configure the real project reference. Production requests require HTTPS; no specific TLS version is assumed.

https://{project_ref}.supabase.co/functions/v1/notifications/evaluate-alerts

Loopback-only local Supabase sandbox. HTTP is permitted only for local development.

http://127.0.0.1:54321/functions/v1/notifications/evaluate-alerts

Read system academic standing thresholds and backup metadata

Read-only PostgREST projection of system/department academic standing delinquency thresholds (warning_pct, probation_pct, dismissal_pct), sender_email, and last_backup_at metadata (FR-SET-01).

Authorizations:
(supabaseProjectKeybearerAuth)
query Parameters
id
string <= 1900 characters ^(?:(?:eq|neq)\.[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}...

Allowlisted PostgREST UUID filter: eq.UUID, neq.UUID or in.(UUID,...), at most 50 IDs. URL-encode the complete value; format:uuid would be wrong for the operator-prefixed string.

department_id
string <= 1900 characters ^(?:(?:eq|neq)\.[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}...

Allowlisted PostgREST UUID filter: eq.UUID, neq.UUID or in.(UUID,...), at most 50 IDs. URL-encode the complete value; format:uuid would be wrong for the operator-prefixed string.

select
string <= 2000 characters ^(?:id|department_id|warning_pct|probation_pc...
Default: "id,department_id,warning_pct,probation_pct,dismissal_pct,sender_email,last_backup_at,last_backup_by,last_backup_reference,last_backup_location,last_backup_scope,updated_at"

Only these flat safe columns.

order
string <= 1000 characters ^(?:id|department_id|warning_pct|probation_pc...
Default: "id.asc"

Stable ordering on published columns only.

limit
integer [ 1 .. 1000 ]
Default: 20
Example: limit=20

Bounded page size; gateway/PostgREST max-rows must enforce this cap even when clients omit or bypass contract validation.

offset
integer [ 0 .. 100000 ]
Default: 0
Example: offset=0

Number of rows to skip for DoS pagination mitigation

Update academic standing delinquency thresholds and sender email
